method: Explicit selected-field copy, canonical omission digests, source-manifest checks and cross-record equality comparisons.
hash_convention: SHA256 over exact member bytes; raw_response_utf8_sha256 over the exact stored string; selected_value_canonical_json_sha256 over UTF-8 JSON sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false.
scope_limits: Six historical accepted LIVE role captures are separate from three controlled principal browser-role outputs.
Nine historical attempts include three failures. Failed raw bodies are not supplied by the attempt records; no missing text or diagnosis is invented.
Asset and media source filenames, inventory identifiers and per-file digests are omitted and represented by field classification plus canonical value digest.
Safe media counts/descriptors and exact user scenario requests are synthetic-demo bounded inputs, not original private media.
Raw response bodies are the short retained structured role responses, not full transport or hidden provider reasoning.
Role outputs and native BSEP remain evidence/candidate information; permission requires current Root review and the execution corridor.
This newly assembled projection is not part of the older sealed public package. It does not grant whole native graph canonical-schema support.
